** Mod Within The Law You agree not to do anything with this tool that is illegal in your jurisdiction. Yes, this means you.
** Support The Developers This is a non-commercial fan project. I will never accept payments or donations. If you like the tool, support the original game. Buy an outfit, V6 your waifu, show appreciation for the people who gave us these characters.
